card: Backports documentation additions to the 29.x release branch, adding references for BIP 433 (Pay to Anchor) and BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to bips.md and updating v29.x release notes. This fixes incomplete documentation tracking in the maintenance branch. The change consists solely of documentation commits already merged in master (#34252 and #36377).
evidence: Commit messages reflect backports of merged documentation PRs #34252 ('doc: add 433 (Pay to Anchor) to bips.md') and #36377 ('doc: add 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to bips.md').
problem: The 29.x maintenance branch is missing documentation entries for BIP 433 and BIP 461 that were merged into master, along with relevant release note updates.

risk.why: Only documentation files are modified, posing no operational or consensus risk.

scope_notes: Targeted at the 29.x branch rather than master; consists entirely of documentation updates.
summary: Backports documentation updates to the 29.x maintenance branch. Specifically, it adds BIP 433 (Pay to Anchor) and BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to `doc/bips.md`, and updates the v29.x release notes.
